1124334.name: brace-expansion
1124334.title: brace-expansion: DoS via unbounded expansion length causing an out-of-memory process crash
1124334.reason: redoc@2.5.3 pins @redocly/openapi-core to ^1.34.15, which depends on the vulnerable minimatch/brace-expansion chain; npm audit fix --force would only resolve this by downgrading redoc to 1.22.3, a breaking major-version regression
1124334.impact: brace-expansion is only exercised by @redocly/openapi-core's CLI glob matching during local bundling and CI; it never processes user-controlled input in the deployed docs site
1124334.wayForward: Monitor redoc for a release that upgrades its @redocly/openapi-core dependency to 2.x (which already uses a patched minimatch/brace-expansion)
